Combined with axiom A2 this gives CLC(f, G) ≥ α · Q(f), tightening axiom A4 in regimes where asdim_R(G) is hard to certify but a Følner witness is available.

(2) For n∈{2,3,4} construct LiftedInputSpace ((X×Y)^n with d_⊕). (3) Build a 3-level FolnerWitness F_1⊂F_2⊂F_3 of d_⊕-balls and run PropertyAExpand by solving a small SDP / Cholesky on the Laplacian of the proximity graph to obtain φ; estimate α by linear regression of log||φ(u)-φ(v)||₂ on log d_⊕(u,v) over sampled pairs.
